question: In which of the following years was the Energy Conservation Amendment Bill passed to mandate non-fossil sources of energy and establish a domestic carbon market in India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 2022**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Energy Conservation Amendment Bill**, which mandates non-fossil sources of energy and establishes a domestic carbon market in India, **was passed in 2022.**
 
• The "Energy Conservation (Amendment) Act, 2022"** was passed to enable the government t**o set up a carbon trading system within the country. 
 
• The bill **aims to promote** the use of renewable energy sources like green hydrogen, biomass, and ethanol. 
 
• It empowers the government to set up a domestic carbon market where companies can trade carbon credits. 
 
• The Act **came into force on January 1, 2023**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Energy Conservation Act, 2001 was the original act aimed at promoting energy efficiency and conservation in India.
 
• The Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) was established under this act to implement various policies and programs.
 
• Energy conservation is crucial for reducing the carbon footprint and combating climate change.
 
• India has committed to reducing its carbon emissions intensity as part of its Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) under the Paris Agreement.
 
• The amendment bill is part of India's efforts to meet its climate goals and promote sustainable development.
